range_rule.uncertain: inside either inclusive brightness mean +/- k sample SD band
range_rule.in_range: strictly between dark upper and bright lower band limits
range_rule.out_of_range: outside both bands and the in-range interval

evaluation_rule.confusion_matrix_rows: actual AP class; definite predictions only
